name: Top list
description: A countdown or a list of things, each with its own short scene. Pick it for rankings, records and collections of facts.

structure.purpose: Promise the list and tease the best item on it.
One scene for each item, numbered on screen, each one a small surprise. Use this beat once per item.
The best one, given the most time and the strongest picture.
One line that sums up the list or asks which the viewer would pick.

hookRules: The first 3 seconds show the most striking image or line. No greeting and no logo intro.
Within 10 seconds it is clear what someone could lose or gain.

rules: Every item and every figure comes from a saved source.
The order of a ranking follows the source, or the video says the order is its own choice.
